comments.author: @gerardhart9052
comments.text: Great video, very factual. Points to note Public hospital wait times can vary widely from about 15 mins to over 18 hours based on activity. Purchases of alcohol, vehicles and tobacco products are very highly taxed. The unofficial exchange rate starts at 7.25 and can go up to 8 to 1USD.. Public transportation is heavily subsidized by cheaper taxes and government spending however punctuality and coverage is well below that of most developed countries. Crime is among the top 10 in the world but mostly follows the 80:20 principle where 80% occurs in 20% of the countries area. Purchasing a traditional 2 bedroom house is usually over a million TTD in most developed areas. Trinidad's culture is typically welcoming and friendly but service in most places is slow and inefficient when compared to the US.
